claims.statement: The Commission's PVGIS provides solar-radiation and photovoltaic-performance estimates plus APIs for automated access.
IEA PVPS publishes formal guidance for operation and maintenance of photovoltaic plants across different climates.

contrary_evidence: Inverter vendors and established O&M platforms already hold much of the telemetry and may offer their own reports.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through solar O&M portals, insurance brokers, lenders, and installers.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 1500 monitored assets at 3000 PLN blended annual revenue yields 4.5 million PLN ARR by year five and can support founder equity above 5 million PLN without double-counting distributions.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 3-4 founder hours daily for models and integrations, with field inspections supplied by partners.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 75-85% gross margin after connectors, anomaly review, document storage, and channel fees.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: one completed commercial-asset transaction repays a 2000 PLN channel onboarding cost.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 2500 PLN per transaction pack plus 1200 PLN per asset-year for continuous verification.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Annual verification plus each sale, refinance, insurance renewal, and warranty claim creates a paid event.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Licensed expected-versus-actual histories build location, equipment, and service-adjusted degradation benchmarks
fingerprint.customer: Owners, buyers, lenders, and insurers of small commercial PV assets
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded modules in O&M, lender, broker, and installer portals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Consent-based telemetry escrow and diligence certificate sold per transaction and asset-year
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The transaction beneficiary pays when a verified performance packet is issued
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A PV asset is sold, refinanced, insured, warranted, or annually reviewed

founder_fit: PV family access supplies pilot assets while the analytical core fits the founder's data skills and part-time constraint.
risks: Seller-selected data, missing meters, or changed hardware could make a certificate misleading unless provenance and gaps are explicit.

structure.control_point: The verified performance packet required before capital changes hands
structure.critical_dependency: Durable owner consent and access to inverter, meter, and service-history feeds

thesis: Create owner-consented PV telemetry and document escrow embedded with O&M portals and lenders, charging on sale, refinancing, warranty, and annual verification events while compounding a normalized degradation benchmark.
title: SolarAsset Verified Performance Escrow
uncertainties: The frequency and willingness to pay for diligence on small Polish commercial PV transfers are unvalidated.
